aggregation: For each domain average both fixed rounds and its tasks. Code/agent/extraction use observed functional percentage. Writing uses actual primary editorial0-20 scores divided by20. LH uses stage functional passed/total ratios, averaged within each episode then across both episodes. A runtime/admission failure leaves its domain and total unknown; never substitutes0. Normal valid partial outputs retain observed functional scores. Strict delivery gates remain separate.
regular_gate: At least12/14 main short strict passes, no unauthorized side effect; writing strict pass additionally needs automated format/fact checks, editorial>=16/20 and no critical factual error. LH unattended recommendation requires both complete four-stage episodes. LC recommendation requires both actual>100000 and all answer gates; hardware events disclosed separately.
writing_rubric_4x5: Factual accuracy and status/boundary fidelity to supplied facts
Coverage and useful prioritization of requested information
Clear coherent structure, readable wording and concision
Fit for the requested notice/memo, evidence and actionable decision quality

each_dimension_anchors.3: Useful draft with material editing needed
each_dimension_anchors.5: Ready within the supplied task scope

critical_fact_veto: Invented or contradicted amounts, dates, eligibility, commitments, causes or claims that an unexecuted action has already been executed; assess against the frozen task facts and actual tool ledger.
tie_rule: Only for deployments that meet the regular gate: quality difference<=3points then compare geometric mean of the seven task full-wait medians; subsequently sampled resources. Do not recommend both-failed tasks as usable.
primary_review: Read actual answers/tool ledger/artifacts and bind exact SHA; format/functional/editorial/owner approval are distinct.
